# Design Button

Link and action buttons in 12 designs (soft, gradient, glass, outline draw, pill arrow, icon circle, 3D press, shimmer, underline, ghost glow, split icon, neon border). Follows the call-to-action patterns of current design systems, built only from the theme palette so each design stays native to Universal Theme. Report mode renders a wrapping action bar.

| | |
|---|---|
| Plug-in type | templateComponent |
| Static ID | `AMC_DESIGN_BUTTON` |
| APEXlang reference | `type: plugin/designButton` |
| Modes | partial (single / report column), report (multiple rows) |
| Minimum APEX | 23.1 (APEXlang import: 26.1+) |
| Version | 1.0.0 |

Use for marketing-style calls to action and hero links; keep native Universal Theme buttons for form actions. Set Link to render an anchor; without a link a button is rendered for a Dynamic Action. Every design has hover, pressed and keyboard focus states and respects reduced motion.

## Settings

| APEXlang setting | Builder label | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `style` | Style | selectList (`soft`, `gradient`, `glass`, `outlineDraw`, `pillArrow`, `iconCircle`, `press3d`, `shimmer`, `underline`, `ghostGlow`, `splitIcon`, `neonBorder`) | yes | `soft` | The button design. Colors always come from the active theme style; shimmer, outline draw and neon border animate only on hover or keyboard focus. |
| `label` | Label | sessionStateValue | yes |  | Visible button text. Use a specific verb, for example Create Order or View Invoices. |
| `linkUrl` | Link | sessionStateValue |  |  | Target URL, for example f?p=&APP_ID.:10:&SESSION. When set an anchor is rendered, otherwise a button for a Dynamic Action. Must be a developer-controlled value, never raw user input. |
| `icon` | Icon | sessionStateValue |  |  | Font APEX icon class, for example fa-plus or fa-download. Icon circle and split icon show a chevron when it is empty. |
| `size` | Size | selectList (`small`, `large`) |  |  | Leave empty for the default size. |

## Install

- **APEX 26.1+ with APEXlang:** copy `dist/apexlang/shared-components/plugins/design-button/` into your app's `shared-components/plugins/`, then run the apexlang skill's format, compiler-truth and runtime validate gates.
- **APEX 23.1 to 25.x (or any version, via App Builder):** import `dist/legacy/amc_design_button.sql` from Shared Components > Plug-ins > Import.
